column1: # GPX tracks for the GPX reader's non-regression test, fetched from Common
# Crawl's archives by tools/fetch-cc-gpx.sh (bmake fetch-test-data); never
# stored in this repository. Selected from CC-GPX (Ilyankou et al., SIGSPATIAL
# 2024, https://github.com/ilyankou/cc-gpx): France and Norway, with GPS
# times or not. The files belong to the sites they were published on.
# Columns: name, warc_file, offset, length, sha256 of the GPX, url, group,
# country, then what OpenRider's GPX reader makes of it: points, route (1 if
# read from <rte>), timed (1 if any point has a time), distance_m,
# duration_s (NaN without times), ascent_m. Groups: recorded (GPS log),
# recorded-12h-clock (times on a 12-hour clock without AM/PM), generated-
# times (planned route stamped at 1 s per point), no-times, no-times-dem
